title: SILO - 7 days in a nuclear silo
author: Monk070
selftext:
**Play in your web-browser:** [HERE](https://monk070.itch.io/silo)

**SILO**

Seven days alone in a missile silo. Turn the key. Make a brew.

CINDER-09. Under what was Birmingham, UK.

The blast door sealed behind you yesterday. Relief is due in seven days. You are the only one down here.

The war above has gone on so long that nobody remembers how it started. Nobody has seen the enemy in a generation. The Ministry of Continuance calls it *THE ENEMY*, and that's all anyone like you needs to know. Your job is to authenticate what comes over the wire, and to turn a key when you're told.
